_comment: The 'what is Stagwell.AI' answer, from the Stagwell.AI Messaging framework (Sep 2026). machine/about.js renders the landing's About section from this file; nothing in it is invented here. Proof points are the framework's own and are shown only where the framework filled in a number — the X placeholders are not rendered — under a line that says they are pending validation, exactly as the framework does.
tagline: Agentic solutions grounded in real-world marketing expertise
positioning: Stagwell.AI is a portfolio of agentic solutions built by Stagwell's marketing experts for businesses, spanning full-service capabilities to self-service tools and designed to work independently or together to accelerate decision-making, improve performance and drive greater ROI.
whoWeAre: Stagwell.AI is Stagwell's portfolio of agentic solutions purpose-built for marketers, combining AI technology with deep marketing expertise to help brands make better decisions, execute faster, and drive stronger performance.
vision: To become the essential AI partner for marketers — transforming how marketing decisions are made, work gets done, and performance is improved.
masterPromise: Agentic solutions + real marketing expertise = smarter decisions, faster execution and better outcomes.

promises.title: Expertise you can activate
promises.line: Agentic solutions infused with real-world marketing expertise.

promises.title: Intelligence that moves to action
promises.line: Move faster from understanding what's happening to deciding what to do and putting it into action.

promises.title: Flexible by design
promises.line: Use one solution, multiple solutions, self-service tools, or full-service capabilities based on your needs.

promises.title: Performance at the center
promises.line: Every solution is designed to improve marketing effectiveness and ROI.

portfolioTitle: One portfolio. Multiple ways to put agentic marketing to work.
portfolioLine: A broad portfolio of agentic capabilities designed for different levels of complexity, scale and support. Adopt one independently, or combine them as your needs evolve.

tiers.name: Enterprise Solutions
tiers.headline: Agentic capabilities for complex, enterprise-scale marketing.
tiers.line: Advanced solutions and full-service capabilities that bring together technology, data and Stagwell expertise to solve complex marketing challenges at scale.
tiers.bestFor: Enterprise brands, global organizations, and sophisticated marketing teams.
tiers.coreValue: Scale, orchestration, customization, and deep expertise.

tiers.name: Purpose-Built Solutions
tiers.headline: Purpose-built agentic solutions for specific marketing challenges.
tiers.line: Focused solutions designed to help marketers solve specific needs across research, communications, media, data, and AI productivity.
tiers.bestFor: Mid-market and enterprise marketers looking to solve a specific use case quickly.
tiers.coreValue: Speed, specialization, and faster time to value.

tiers.name: Self-Service Platform
tiers.headline: Agentic marketing expertise made accessible to growing businesses.
tiers.line: Self-service tools that give small and growing businesses access to sophisticated marketing capabilities without requiring large teams, agencies or complex technology stacks.
tiers.bestFor: Small businesses and lean marketing teams.

tiersColorNote: the category colour code is the brand board's (Concept Final V3.1): orange = Stagwell Machines, cyan = Purpose-Built Solutions, marigold = Self-Service Platform

reasons.title: Marketing expertise, built in
reasons.line: Built by the marketers, strategists, researchers, creatives, data scientists and technologists who solve complex marketing challenges every day.

reasons.title: Purpose-built for marketing
reasons.line: Designed around specific marketing decisions, workflows and use cases — not generic AI applied to marketing.

reasons.title: Connected to best-in-class technology
reasons.line: Built on and connected to the strongest tools, models and infrastructure in the market, with leading technology partners.

reasons.title: Built for every marketing model
reasons.line: Full-service to self-service, enterprise to SMB — choose the level of support and technology that fits.

reasons.title: Powerful alone, stronger together
reasons.line: Each solution delivers value on its own and connects as needs evolve — no one-size-fits-all platform lock-in.
